decided.singular: Days 1, 121, 135 and 365 have daily max of about 90-117 while their daily mean is ordinary (about 20), so they are single-hour spikes; day 174 (max 86, mean 23) and day 239 (max 85, mean 34.5) are similar; days 68-69 (means 58-65) and 40-44 (means 40-56) are sustained high-mean runs.
decided.highest: Q1 has many days with mean above 25-50 and the largest sustained peaks, while the other quarters mostly sit at about 10-20.
decided.lowest: Q3 has the longest stretches with mean around 10-13 and few elevated episodes, slightly below Q2 and Q4.
decided.recurrence: Elevated episodes (about days 18-22, 35, 40-44, 52, 66-70, 79-84) come roughly 14 days apart early in the year and are irregular later, with no steady 5-10 day period.

answer.guess: Geomagnetic or solar-wind activity index (hourly), possibly noise or a similar spiky natural series.
